name: Apache Kafka
summary: Event streaming, developer experience, and real-time processing.

tools.name: Factor House · Kpow
tools.walkthrough: Inspect topics, messages, consumer lag and Connect.

tools.name: Lenses.io
tools.walkthrough: Explore streaming SQL and governed developer workflows.

tools.name: Conduktor
tools.walkthrough: Demonstrate self-service, governance and Kafka operations.

tools.name: AKHQ
tools.walkthrough: Browse topics and consumer groups using read-only access.

tools.name: Kafbat UI
tools.walkthrough: Explore partitions, message payloads and group offsets.

tools.name: RisingWave
tools.walkthrough: Create a streaming source and continuously updated materialized view.

tools.name: Streambased
tools.walkthrough: Explore Kafka data through an Iceberg-compatible analytics layer.

tools.name: Kafka Connect
tools.walkthrough: Move data between Kafka and external systems.

tools.name: DataGrip
tools.walkthrough: Explore Kafka topics as SQL tables using the third-party KafCacheQL JDBC driver. DataGrip is a desktop IDE, not a native Kafka browser.
tools.description: JetBrains database IDE with SQL exploration via the third-party KafCacheQL JDBC driver.

tools.name: KafCacheQL
tools.walkthrough: Use SELECT queries against bounded Kafka topic snapshots in DataGrip or DBeaver, including joins and aggregations. Experimental, not a continuous streaming engine.
tools.description: Experimental Apache-2.0 JDBC driver for read-only SQL over locally cached Kafka records.
